faqs.question: How can I check attendance?
faqs.answer: Please check the official college attendance portal or contact your class coordinator.

faqs.question: When are exams conducted?
faqs.answer: Please check the latest official college examination notice for exam dates.

faqs.question: How can I know lab timings?
faqs.answer: Please contact your department or lab in-charge for the current lab timetable.

faqs.question: Where can I find college events?
faqs.answer: Please check official college announcements or contact the event coordinator.
